title: An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization: Supporting Data and Code
description: This software and data release accompanies the manuscript “An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization” and its Supplementary Information by Gagan Sai Amith Pennada (School of Computer Science and Engineering, VIT-AP University, India). It is intended to preserve the synthetic reference dataset, the 20-seed cross-validation/ablation/TreeSHAP metrics log, the positive-control and learning-curve log, source code, and supplementary documentation. The manuscript and Supplementary Information are companion documents and do not have separate DOIs identified in the supplied files. The Zenodo DOI assigned to this deposit identifies the supporting software/data record, not an independent DOI for the manuscript.
references: Pennada, Gagan Sai Amith. An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization. Manuscript. School of Computer Science and Engineering, VIT-AP University, India.

Pennada, Gagan Sai Amith. Supplementary Information for “An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization”. VIT-AP University, India.
